math: For each valid token t, head h and channel d, write K[t,h,d] to Kcache[loc[t]//64,h,loc[t]%64,d] and V[t,h,d] to Vcache[loc[t]//64,h,d,loc[t]%64], preserving all other cache cells.

scope.integration: SGLang Python/Triton startup Overlay under hcu-auto-opt M1

inputs: loc: int64[N], nonnegative distinct valid cache slot IDs
cache_k/cache_v: BF16[N,H,D], arbitrary observed input strides
outputs: Kcache and Vcache mutated in place, with untouched cells preserved
layout: DCU FA paged K [P,H,64,D], V [P,H,D,64]; observed input strides [1152,64,1]

acceptance.correctness: Independent full-cache K/V oracle including untouched cells, page boundaries, permuted distinct loc, noncontiguous inputs, and fallback behavior for unsupported capture/dtype/stream states
acceptance.baseline: Locked SGLang set_kv_buffer advanced-index implementation; formal verdict only through the existing B Harness and D adjudicator
